Real-data re-sign proof, 2026-11-20 15:03–18:10 PST (evidence for minimum-seedy-lowchen's two [non-codebase] criteria).

Setup: frozen T0 = origin/tickets efcf5ae2b97 fetched by commit into an empty repo with no remote, cloned to a `file://` fake remote and a shadow tracker inside a scratch workdir; signing keys loaded from SSM only into a private bounded ssh-agent. The proof itself published only to the fake remote — it executed no production swap. (The production swap was a separate, later step, run only after this GO and under the operator's standing approval; see the publication comment above.)

Enforced `verify-identity --all`, no `enforce_since`, `REBAR_IDENTITY_REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATED=1`:
- before: exit 1 — 44039 verified, 865 unsigned, 0 unknown-author, 0 bad-signature, 0 key-not-valid-at-era, 6514 signer-not-on-keyring (51418 in scope)
- after: exit 0 — 51418 verified, 0 non-verified (51418 in scope)

Reduced state, original vs rewritten: 53588 differing paths, 0 outside the allowed set; differing leaf kinds are only `author_id`, `commit_sha`, `signature`, `signed`, `signer_pubkey`, `unsigned` (authorship counts, added author_ids, ledger signature fields).

Collapse: boundary 71e0dda7fcd, 297924 commits collapsed, 14232 replayed, 77848 ledger entries rewritten (fast-import), 2158 events and 4978 ledger entries re-signed; enforce-since commit 5c52eea14d1 is on the new branch. Commits 312156 -> 14235; blobless pack 625 MiB -> 108 MiB.

Per-step seconds: fetch_t1 127.0, fake_remote 118.4, shadow 144.8, reduce_before 51.5, pack_before 160.5, verify_before 7413.6, build_resign_plan 813.3, collapse 1583.4, stamp_epoch 1.6, publish_fake 24.8, pack_after 7.0, verify_after 736.4, reduce_after 5.6.

Driver verdict: `GO new_tip=6a6dda16fc78fb3f2a8b5d8826ac130034b808bd t1=efcf5ae2b972fc804603f58b5d3e4d1d0eb90102`.
